related.title: LSTM 循環時序網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算；LSTM 循環時序網路改以閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation; LSTM recurrent sequence network centers on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照token與位置張量與input與hidden state，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到LSTM 循環時序網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以長序列與分佈移轉為起點，設計一項能區分「QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算」與「閘控記憶、共享權重與長時序梯度」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare token and position tensors with input/hidden states and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to LSTM recurrent sequence network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from long-sequence distribution shift and propose an observation distinguishing qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation from gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients, including uncertainty.

related.title: GAT 圖注意力網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算；GAT 圖注意力網路改以鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation; GAT graph attention network centers on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照token與位置張量與節點與邊張量，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到GAT 圖注意力網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以長序列與分佈移轉為起點，設計一項能區分「QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算」與「鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare token and position tensors with node and edge tensors and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to GAT graph attention network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from long-sequence distribution shift and propose an observation distinguishing qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation from neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning, including uncertainty.
